action_summary: Hand over what the row found when the sentence names no collection: the result surface ranked by the sentence's own words, and a named answer lifted verbatim. No verdict changes.
intent: Hand over what the row found when the sentence names no collection: the result surface ranked by the sentence's own words, and a named answer lifted verbatim. No verdict changes.
causal_blocker: A PASS hands the caller nothing. Measured 2026-11-01 on 34124aa by re-running the repository's own 49-sentence advanced census and its 54-case capability matrix and recording the one field neither instrument records (answer): the census serves 34 of 49 and ONE of the 34 delivered an answer; the matrix is 42 of 54 REAL and FIVE of the 42 delivered one. Seventy of the 77 passing executions wrote a report to output_path holding the answer -- hot_spot_function, root_causes, findings, vulnerabilities, migration_steps, adr_markdown, test_evidence -- and the door read none of them, because answer_shape_v1.asked() recognises thirteen nouns and every other sentence fell through 'shape is None' to 'return []'. The work was done, the row named its findings, and the caller was told nothing.
measured_effect: Every PASS now hands over what its row found, without inventing anything. Census: 34 of 34 served sentences deliver an answer (was 1 of 34) -- 'Profile X and tell me which function is the hot spot' -> hot_spot_function, 'find the root cause' -> root_causes, 'audit the dependency list for known vulnerabilities' -> vulnerabilities, 'write an ADR' -> adr_markdown, 'plan the migration' -> migration_steps, 'which tests fail and why' -> test_evidence. Matrix: 42 of 42 REAL cases deliver one (was 5 of 42), including the two rows that answer with a field literally named 'answer' (python.source.complexity.v1, python.source.definition_count.v1), which are lifted verbatim rather than re-shaped. No verdict moved: the same 34 of 49 and 42 of 54 pass, the 16 pre-existing failures in the 40 test modules that touch the door are byte-identical before and after (measured by stashing the change and re-running), and the pinned laws hold -- test_the_answer_must_be_the_answer_v1 (17 tests), test_a_single_named_answer_is_not_an_enumeration_v1 (3), test_a_large_artifact_is_read_by_section_v1, test_stated_input_coverage_v1's projection cases, and test_a_certificate_requires_the_work_v1 (9).
expected_parent_frontier_change: Every PASS carries the answer its row produced, so the 34 of 49 and 42 of 54 that already succeed become usable rather than silent.
expected_parent_change: Every PASS carries the answer its row produced, so the 34 of 49 and 42 of 54 that already succeed become usable rather than silent.
stop_condition: Stop when the 15 new law tests are green, the census delivers 34 of 34 and the matrix 42 of 42, and the pre-existing red set is byte-identical.
falsification_condition: Re-run the 49 census sentences and the 54 matrix cases: any PASS that hands over nothing while its row held findings, any answer that replaces one the route already set, any change to the 16 pre-existing failures, or any verdict that moves falsifies this intent.
prior_work_reused: answer_shape_v1's existing envelope, _bounded bound, asked() classification and the _BOOKKEEPING surface idea from _supplied_by_any; the door's single exit _close_observations; the row's own result, which already holds the answer. No new capability, adapter, registry row, schema, dependency or model call.
explicit_user_authorization: Owner instruction this session, verbatim: 'Do the optimal in the fastest way. Everything must be insanely fast, only the right way. and merge all of your work.' and, on scope: 'hardcore software engineering only; PDF/DOCX/XLSX work is not to be counted or pursued', with the target stated as 'the most advanced, fastest, smartest software engineer'. qualification_evidence: jsonschema 4.26.0 is installed-checkable from pypi.org and validates a declared schema deterministically

comparison.CORRECTNESS: It answers 'does this payload match the schema I declared', never 'does this payload answer the sentence'.
comparison.CAPABILITY_STRENGTH: Needs one schema per sentence shape, which is the vocabulary this change already owns.
comparison.WALL_CLOCK: Comparable on a hot dict, but the schema has to be derived from the sentence first.
comparison.INCREMENTAL_COST: Adds a third-party dependency to a zero-dependency, zero-spend producer path.
comparison.RELIABILITY: Deterministic, but vacuous without the sentence mapping.
comparison.VERIFIABILITY: Its own errors are precise; they cannot name the missing collection.

qualification_evidence: jmespath 1.1.0 and glom 25.12.0 both project a caller-supplied path over nested JSON

comparison.CORRECTNESS: Correct on the path it is given; choosing the path from the sentence is exactly the remaining problem.
comparison.CAPABILITY_STRENGTH: Strictly narrower: no notion of a noun, an alias table, or a refusal reason.
comparison.WALL_CLOCK: Microseconds for a compiled expression, but the expression is per-sentence work.
comparison.INCREMENTAL_COST: Third-party dependency for a 40-line breadth-first lookup.
comparison.RELIABILITY: Deterministic; adds an install requirement to every environment.
comparison.VERIFIABILITY: Returns the wrong thing silently when the path misses, where the gate must refuse.

qualification_evidence: GroundEval reports deterministic scoring of what an agent fetched, cited and returned, with no judge model

comparison.CORRECTNESS: Strong on 'did the agent use the artifact', silent on 'is the payload the answer'.
comparison.CAPABILITY_STRENGTH: An evaluation harness with its own domain configuration, not a runtime gate.
comparison.INCREMENTAL_COST: A framework plus a question corpus to sit in the producer path.
comparison.RELIABILITY: Good for audits; would not run on every solve.
comparison.VERIFIABILITY: Independent by construction, which is why it is useful as an auditor rather than as the gate.
